CURRENT SCENE:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

ITEMS:

[I209] 有一个【老男人】叫神农   correction: 老男人 → 老人   strength: error
  checker's note: 老人 is the normal term for an elderly man.
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: [一个老先生叫神农→有一个叫神农的老先生]
  her past correction: 在古代[有一个神农→有一个叫神农的老人]
  her past correction: ⟦很久以前，在古代⟧有一个叫神农的老人 — her note: “很久以前“ and ”在古代” are redundant, only keep one

[I210] 神农在古代每一天看到【了】别的小镇人生病还是不舒服   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  rule card (no_le_routine_state, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): For a routine, habit, repeated condition, or state, use zero particle: do not add 了completed. This is especially true with words such as 老是, 常常, and 从早到晚.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this describes a routine/habit or repeated condition, so use no 了 (no了for routine/habit).  Her terms: no了for routine/habit, no了for habit/routine, 看look vs.看到see, no了
  her past correction: 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 神农不喜欢看他的城市生病[-了] — her note: 看look vs.看到see, no了
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

[I211] 神农在古代每一天看到了别的【小镇人】生病还是不舒服   correction: 小镇人 → 镇上的人   strength: error
  checker's note: 小镇人 is not the normal expression for townspeople.
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看了很多生病的人 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 神农不喜欢看他的城市生病[-了] — her note: 看look vs.看到see, no了

[I212] 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病【还是】不舒服   correction: 还是 → 或者   strength: error
  checker's note: a declarative alternative uses 或者, not 还是.
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看了很多生病的人 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 神农不喜欢看他的城市生病[-了] — her note: 看look vs.看到see, no了

[I213] 他【下】一天开始爬当地的山脉   correction: 下 → 第   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他[到山→到了山上]以后 — her note: 了completed, 山上is a place
  her past correction: [-所以]他去了又空又高的山 — her note: “所以” is inappropriate because here is not a result, delete it, add “为了找到没有毒的植物”
  her past correction: 他[爬山→爬了很多山]

[I214] 他下一天开始爬当地的【山脉】   correction: 山脉 → 山   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 爬山 is the usual expression; one does not normally 爬 a whole mountain range.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他[到山→到了山上]以后 — her note: 了completed, 山上is a place
  her past correction: 他[爬山→爬了很多山]
  her past correction: 他走过[有大有小山→大山小山]

[I215] 【找了】各种各样的植物   correction: 找了 → 找到了   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 找了 -> 找到了 (corrected 3/5 in train)
  rule card (search_find, Vocabulary): 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person successfully finds <object>, so use 找到, not 找.  Her terms: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他[找有的花→找到一种植物] — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他找到了很多[-的]中国的植物
  her past correction: 他尝[+了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed

[I216] 神农【试一试】每个植物   correction: 试一试 → 试了试   strength: error
  checker's note: a completed past action needs 了 in this verb reduplication.
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 就[测试→尝试]更植物
  her past correction: 他[测试→尝试]别的植物
  her past correction: 他测试别的植物[+尝试了很多年]

[I217] 神农试一试每【个】植物   correction: 个 → 种   strength: error
  checker's note: plants take the measure word 种 here.
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 就[测试→尝试]更植物
  her past correction: 他[测试→尝试]别的植物
  her past correction: 他测试[别的→各种]植物 — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

[I218] 知道【^】有什么好处   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: knowing is a completed change of state in this narrative.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 结果他取得[+了]生活经验 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 感觉得身体健康[+了]
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]

items.explanation: Use 老人 for an elderly man; 老男人 is not the normal term here.
This describes a routine with 每一天, so use no 了 for routine/habit.
Use 镇上的人 for people in a town; 小镇人 is not the normal expression.
This is a statement with alternatives, so use 或者, not 还是.
It would be more natural to say 第一天 for “the first day”; 下一天 usually means “the next day.”
It would be more natural to say 爬山. 山脉 is a mountain range, not usually the object of 爬.
He successfully finds the plants, so use 找到, not 找: 找look for vs. 找到find.
This action is completed in the story, so use 试了试 with 了completed.
Use 种 because it is the measure word for types of plants.
Knowing the benefits is a completed change in the story, so it takes 了completed.
